text: Age 18 years or older at diagnosis.
dataNeeded: Age at diagnosis in whole years and the diagnosis date. Source: demographics or clinic letter. eCRF fields: AGE (years), MHSTDAT (date of diagnosis).

text: Histologically confirmed glioblastoma, ICD-O-3 morphology 9440/3, IDH-wildtype (WHO CNS5, 2021).
dataNeeded: Pathology report with ICD-O-3 morphology code and an IDH1/2 result of wildtype. Source: pathology and molecular report. eCRF fields: HISTOLOGY, IDHSTAT.

text: MGMT promoter methylation status is known (methylated or unmethylated).
dataNeeded: MGMT promoter methylation result that is methylated or unmethylated. Source: molecular pathology report. eCRF field: MGMTPROM.

text: Karnofsky Performance Status 60 or higher, recorded within 7 days before registration.
dataNeeded: KPS score (0-100, steps of 10) and its assessment date. Source: clinic or discharge letter. eCRF field: KPS.

text: Adequate bone-marrow function: ANC 1.5 x10^9/L or higher, platelets 100 x10^9/L or higher, haemoglobin 9.0 g/dL or higher.
dataNeeded: ANC, platelet count and haemoglobin values with specimen date and reference ranges. Source: haematology laboratory report.

text: Adequate hepatic function: ALT 3 xULN or lower and total bilirubin 1.5 xULN or lower (3 xULN or lower if Gilbert syndrome).
dataNeeded: ALT and total bilirubin values with the local upper limit of normal (ULN) and specimen date. Source: chemistry laboratory report.

text: Adequate renal function: serum creatinine 1.5 xULN or lower, or eGFR 50 mL/min/1.73 m2 or higher.
dataNeeded: Serum creatinine with local ULN, or eGFR value, and specimen date. Source: chemistry laboratory report.

text: Post-surgical contrast-enhanced MRI is available and evaluable per RANO, and the participant has recovered from surgery (2 weeks or more after craniotomy, or 1 week or more after biopsy).
dataNeeded: MRI report with date and RANO assessment, operative note with surgery type and date, and a clinical note on post-surgical recovery. eCRF field: EXTRES.

text: Participant is able to give written informed consent and to comply with the visit schedule.
dataNeeded: Signed and dated informed consent form, plus a clinical note on ability to comply. Source: consent form and clinic letter.

text: Any prior radiotherapy to the brain.
dataNeeded: Radiotherapy history for the brain, with dates and site. Source: oncology history in the clinic letter or radiotherapy record.

text: Prior systemic anti-glioma therapy (chemotherapy, targeted therapy or immunotherapy), except corticosteroids.
dataNeeded: Systemic treatment history with agent names and dates. Source: treatment history in the clinic letter.

text: Tumour is IDH-mutant, or IDH status is indeterminate or not assessable.
dataNeeded: IDH1/2 result (mutant, wildtype or indeterminate). Source: pathology and molecular report. eCRF field: IDHSTAT.

text: Participant is pregnant or breastfeeding; participants with reproductive potential must have a negative pregnancy test.
dataNeeded: Pregnancy test result with date, and a clinical note on breastfeeding status. Source: laboratory report and clinic letter. eCRF field: SEX.
